newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Ivorian yr/yr inflation rises to 6.4 pct in April.
newsitem.headline: Ivorian yr/yr inflation rises to 6.4 pct in April.

text.p: Ivory Coast's year-on-year inflation rose to 6.4 percent in April from 6.1 percent in March, according to provisional figures from the national statistics institute.

The figures showed a rise of 0.9 percent in prices in April compared with March, mainly due to an increase in food prices, which have risen 5.6 and 4.4 percent since the beginning of the year for blue- and white-collar workers respectively.
The blue-collar consumer price index (base year November 1992 to October 1993) rose to a provisional 157.8 in April from 156.3 in March.
The white-collar consumer price index rose to a provisional 149.1 in April from 148.0 in March.
The year-on-year inflation rate in April 1996 was 1.3 percent. --Abidjan newsroom +225 21 90 90
